name: gpt-5-6-router
description: Opt-in API classification selects a user-allowlisted Codex model and effort. Legacy deterministic routing remains available.

interface.shortDescription: Best-effort Codex delegation and experimental direct execution
interface.longDescription: The plugin selects an allowlisted model and effort and requests best-effort native delegation. Experimental autorouter run submits one new Codex root turn with explicit model settings. Submitted settings are not runtime attestation. Optional classification uses the OpenAI API account, while native direct execution uses Codex through ChatGPT sign-in. Codex permissions and model restrictions still apply. Direct execution has limited macOS CLI acceptance. Legacy deterministic GPT-6 Luna or Sol routing with a gated Astra tier remains available.
defaultPrompt: Show the current routing configuration without making model calls.
Explain the API billing and hook permissions before setup.
Route this task using only my configured model and effort allowlist.
